name: Blair McClenachan
bio: a Representative from Pennsylvania; born in Ireland, c. 1735; immigrated to the United States at an early age and settled in Philadelphia, Pa.; engaged in mercantile pursuits and in banking and shipping; served in the Revolutionary War; one of the founders of and served with the First Troop of Philadelphia Cavalry; in 1780 he subscribed a large sum of money to help the American forces and aided the Continental Congress with money and credit; member of the Pennsylvania state house of representatives, 1790-1795; elected as a Democratic Republican to the Fifth Congress (March 4, 1797-March 3, 1799); died in Philadelphia, Pa., May 9, 1812; interment in a vault in St. Paul's Cemetery.
